product_id.description: Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by search_products, in bp_<id> form.

period_days.description: Requested history window in days for series and data_gaps. deal_classification and price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct always compare with the 180-day median; window_stats always carries the 30-, 90- and 180-day statistics. Use 180 unless the user asks otherwise.
